description: This file defines an abstract Logger class used within the Android Monkey testing framework to handle logging at different levels (standard output and logcat). It provides static logger instances and methods to log errors with stack traces.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: An abstract class that provides a framework for logging messages and errors, with two concrete instances for standard output and logcat.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Abstract method to print a string message. Implemented differently in 'out' and 'err' instances.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Static method to log an error message along with a throwable's stack trace.
